# Feature: Docs Config Location Correction

## Overview
Repository docs currently misrepresent the locations of the frontend and backend formatter configs. `AGENTS.md:84-87`, `AGENTS.md:129-148`, `CLAUDE.md:14-18`, `CLAUDE.md:68-84`, `README.md:60-68`, and `docs/blueprint.md` Technology Stack / Project Structure sections list `biome.json` and `pyproject.toml` as if they live at the repository root, while the actual files are `client/biome.json:1` and `backend/pyproject.toml:1` (verified `Test-Path "biome.json" == False`, `Test-Path "client/biome.json" == True`). This feature corrects every stale path, heading, and shell example so new contributors and AI agents navigate to the correct config without guesswork. No runtime code changes.

## User Stories
- **As a developer**, I want docs to point to `client/biome.json` and `backend/pyproject.toml` so my formatter/linter commands target the right file on first try.
- **As an AI agent**, I want `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` Environment & Configuration Locations to list the true config paths so automated edits do not create duplicate root configs.
- **As a contributor**, I want `README.md` and `docs/blueprint.md` project-structure diagrams and Quick Start notes to match the filesystem the repo actually ships.

### Data Model (Mock)
No data model. The invariant to enforce:
```js
// Filesystem truth (already on disk)
{ exists: "client/biome.json", missing: "biome.json" }
{ exists: "backend/pyproject.toml", missing: "pyproject.toml" }
{ exists: "client/package.json", exists: "backend/requirements.txt" }

// Docs after fix must satisfy
docsContain("client/biome.json") === true
docsContain("backend/pyproject.toml") === true
docsContain("\n├── biome.json") === false  // no root biome.json entry in tree
docsContain("\n├── pyproject.toml") === false
```

### Simulated Backend
No backend change. Verification is file-system and text-search based. Optional helper: run `Select-String -Pattern "biome\.json|pyproject\.toml" -Path AGENTS.md,CLAUDE.md,README.md,docs/blueprint.md` before/after to preview diff.

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. **Inventory stale refs**: Grep all markdown under repo root for `biome\.json` and `pyproject\.toml`:
   - `Select-String -Path "AGENTS.md","CLAUDE.md","README.md","docs/blueprint.md" -Pattern "biome\.json|pyproject\.toml"` — note every hit that claims a root location or omits the `client/` / `backend/` prefix.
   - Confirm filesystem truth: `Test-Path "client/biome.json"`, `Test-Path "backend/pyproject.toml"`, `Test-Path "biome.json"`, `Test-Path "pyproject.toml"`.
2. **Fix `AGENTS.md`**:
   - In `## 4. Useful Development Commands / Environment & Configuration Locations` ensure bullets read `- **Frontend formatter and linter**: `client/biome.json`.` and `- **Backend formatter and linter**: `backend/pyproject.toml`.\` (they already do for backend; frontend bullet must point to `client/biome.json` not `biome.json`).
   - In `## 3. Formatting & Code Style Standards` headings change `### Frontend (Biome-JS — `biome.json`)` → `### Frontend (Biome-JS — `client/biome.json`)` and `### Backend (Python — `pyproject.toml`)` → `### Backend (Python — `backend/pyproject.toml`)` for precision.
   - In `## 6. Project Structure` tree move `biome.json` under `client/` and `pyproject.toml` under `backend/`; delete the two root-level rows `├── biome.json` / `├── pyproject.toml`.
3. **Fix `CLAUDE.md`**:
   - Mirror the same heading and bullet edits in `## 1. Quick Commands / Environment & Configuration Locations` and `## 2. Formatting & Code Style Standards`.
   - Update the ascii tree identical to AGENTS.md.
4. **Fix `README.md`**:
   - Update `## Environment & Configuration Locations` bullets to `client/biome.json` / `backend/pyproject.toml`.
   - Update `## Formatting & Code Style Standards` headings same as above.
   - Update project-structure diagram if it lists root configs.
   - Keep Quick Start commands referencing `cd client && pnpm check` (Biome reads `client/biome.json` automatically); do not add a root `biome.json` invocation.
5. **Fix `docs/blueprint.md`**:
   - Amend `### Technology Stack` frontend bullet `Biome-JS (client/biome.json)` and backend bullet `Ruff/Black (backend/pyproject.toml)`.
   - Ensure no blueprint section still claims root config files.
6. **Cross-check no new drift**: Re-run grep from step 1. Assert zero occurrences of root-only `├── biome.json` / `├── pyproject.toml` in tree diagrams; any remaining bare `biome.json` mention must be qualified as `client/biome.json` in prose.
7. **Sanity build**: Run `cd client && pnpm check` to prove Biome still resolves `client/biome.json`; run `ruff format --check backend/` (or `ruff check backend/`) to prove `backend/pyproject.toml` still governs formatting. No code change should be needed.
8. **Commit etiquette**: This feature ships independently — no dependency on API delay or CSS refactor.
